text:
Megan: Hey folks — bringing our 9-month-old to the offsite next week. Any tips for long layovers/connecting flights? We're flying SFO->JFK with a 3h connection in DEN.
Raul: Congrats! Pack a baby carrier and gate-check the stroller. Much easier than wrestling a collapsible one. Also bring a small blanket as a nursing cover.
Sadia: Bring extra zip-locks for dirty clothes and used bibs. Also, small insulated bag + frozen ice pack for expressed milk if you pump.
Noah: If you can, pick seats by the bulkhead for extra space. On many US carriers you can request the bassinet on long-haul, but it fills up fast.
Tess: For connections — ask gate agents about early boarding for families. Makes transitions less chaotic. Also change the baby closer to takeoff/landing to help ears.
Megan: Any tricks for midnight layover naps? Hoping they sleep on the plane.
Raul: White noise app + tiny travel blackout blanket. But honestly, schedule stuff so there's short active time before nap. Try to sync with home nap clock.
Sadia: Pro tip — bring a pacifier clipped to outfit. When baby cries on takeoff, pop it in, instant calming 50% of time :pray:.
Noah: Pumping/storage note — TSA allows breast milk and formula but declare it at security. Liquids rule is flexible for babies.
Tess: Car seat on board? If budget allows, bring the FAA-approved car seat for the plane. Much safer and gives a space for the baby to sleep.
Megan: What about airport lounges? Any family-friendly ones in DEN?
Raul: United Club in DEN has family bathrooms and a quieter corner. Delta SkyClub sometimes has changing tables but no playroom. Check lounge access early.
GateBot: FYI — stroller gate-check tip: collapse but leave harness buckled to avoid lost straps. Photo the tag.
Sadia: Packing checklist (short):
- 6 diapers, travel-sized wipes
- 3 outfits + zip-locks
- 2 bottles, formula or pumped milk
- baby carrier, small blanket
- pacifier, small toys
- travel changing pad
- emergency meds

Noah: Also, coordinate with hotel about a crib. Call ahead — don’t assume one will be ready.
Tess: If anyone wants, I have a spare nursing cover/portable changing pad you can borrow for the trip. Message me.
Megan: Amazing — this helps so much. Thank you! Will take the bulkhead and gate-check. :baby::airplane::heart:
Raul: Good luck! Pics of mini Redwood rep wearing the swag encouraged :grin:
